title: Open-object cohomology map commutes with arbitrary Ext pullback
statement: For $g:Y\to X$, an open $W$, an abelian sheaf $G$, $q\geq0$, and any $x\in\mathrm{Ext}^q(A_W,G)$ with $A_W$ from [def-weil-pbc-etale-open-object-cohomology-map], the open-object cohomology map sends $\mathrm{mk}_0(k)\circ g^*x$ to the open cohomology pullback [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] of the open-object image of $x$, where inverse image is [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and $k$ is [def-weil-pbc-etale-open-free-sheaf-pullback]. No resolutions or represented cocycles are used.

proof.text: Expand the two cohomology maps. Move degree-zero precomposition through exact inverse image with Ext.mapExactFunctor_comp and mapExactFunctor_mk₀. Apply etaleOpenFreeSheafUnit_pullback to identify the source morphisms. Apply exactFunctorCompositionComparison to both factorizations through h = (g⁻¹W).ι >> g. Precompose and postcompose the first comparison with its inverse components; the hom/inv cancellations isolate the mapped Ext class. Ext associativity and mk₀ composition give exactly the desired coefficient transport.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleOpenObjectCohomologyMap_pullback
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) (W : X.Opens)
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ)
    (x : Abelian.Ext ((etaleOpenFreeSheaf X).obj (Scheme.Etale.mk W.ι)) G q) :
    etaleOpenObjectCohomologyMap ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj G)
      q (g ⁻¹ᵁ W)
        ((Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (etaleOpenFreeSheafPullback g W)).comp
          (x.mapExactFunctor (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g)) (zero_add q)) =
      openCohomologyPullback g W G q (etaleOpenObjectCohomologyMap G q W x)
